data.one_liner: Google reCAPTCHA v3 plugin for Flutter Web.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter web apps to initialize Google reCAPTCHA v3 and generate tokens to protect websites from spam and abuse. It automatically injects the necessary script tag and provides methods for handling execution tokens, badge visibility, and error management.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application
You need to protect web forms or user actions against spam and bots using reCAPTCHA v3
You require reCAPTCHA Enterprise or recaptcha.net fallback support on the web
avoid_when: You are targeting non-web platforms primarily (iOS, Android)
You need reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox widgets instead of invisible v3 tokens
strengths: Automatically injects the reCAPTCHA script tag without requiring manual index.html modifications
Supports WebAssembly (WASM) builds and reCAPTCHA Enterprise
Provides advanced options like badge hiding, custom badge languages, and CSP nonces
weaknesses: Platform support is strictly limited to Flutter Web
Requires manual configuration and site keys set up in the Google reCAPTCHA admin console
data.setup_notes: Create keys in the Google reCAPTCHA console, add the package to pubspec.yaml, and call GRecaptchaV3.ready with your site key.
